description: This file is a shell script used to set up and test a Git repository for a Perl interface (Git.pm). It contains commands for creating files, directories, adding and committing to Git, configuring Git settings, and running a test Perl script. The script coordinates test environment setup and validation for the Perl interface.

methods.name: skip_all_if_no_Test_More
methods.description: Skips all tests if the Test::More module is not available.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and commands to execute.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the specified file or stream (stderr) is empty after test execution.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test script execution.
